shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
The Kilemeno Ocean. Once a fishing route.
Now a graveyard of derricks and broken treaties.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
Acaristan. A nation in name only.
The ground beneath it is worth more than the people standing on it.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
The IPA promises rebuilding.
Their oil flows. Their guns sell.
Their hands are clean - for the cameras.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
MAG promises freedom.
They bomb checkpoints. They bury their dead in unmarked steppes.
The state calls them terrorists. The poor call them family.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
And then there is KRAP.
Koaliția Regională de Apărare Și Pace.
Peacekeepers, they call themselves.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
They keep the highways open.
They keep the oil moving.
They keep the questions unasked.

shots.caption: box
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
Today, one of their operators arrives.
He has been told this is a stabilization assignment.
He has not been told the truth.

ACARISTAN CITY
OPERATION: BLACK NOTEBOOK
DAY 1
